modules.title: 一个待办项目里，谁负责把页面跑出来？
这些工具怎样接成一个可运行的项目

items.title: 同一件小事
items.text: 待办文字要先写进文件，浏览器才有内容可以显示。

items.title: 分工接上
items.text: 有的工具帮你安排页面，有的工具把间距和颜色变出来，还有工具负责在电脑或网站上启动它。

items.title: 组合不是越多越好
items.text: 能让同一个项目顺利打开、点击和发布的搭配，就已经够用。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 技术栈不是一张必装清单。适合 vibe coding 的常见新手全栈组合是：Next.js (框架) + Tailwind CSS (样式) + shadcn/ui (组件) + Supabase (数据库) + Vercel (托管)，但最合适的技术栈始终取决于具体项目需求。

lessonPractice.title: Agent 建议把现有项目的页面、数据服务和部署方式全部换成热门工具，但还没看当前代码。应该先做什么？

options.label: 先盘点现有语言、框架、数据服务和运行方式，再判断具体替换收益
options.feedback: 技术栈描述的是项目实际分工，只有知道现状和约束，替换才有可比较的成本与结果。

options.label: 按热度一次替换全部工具，完成后再处理兼容和迁移问题
options.feedback: 同时改变多层会扩大风险和排查范围，流行程度也不能证明适合当前项目。

options.label: 只记录几个产品名称，不说明它们分别负责页面、数据还是部署
options.feedback: 品牌清单没有表达职责，无法判断重复能力、缺口或某项替换会影响哪里。

en.title: An Agent proposes replacing a project's UI, data service, and deployment with popular tools before inspecting the code. What should happen first?

options.label: Inventory current languages, frameworks, data services, and runtime before judging replacement value
options.feedback: A stack describes actual responsibilities, and only current constraints make replacement cost and outcome comparable.

options.label: Replace every layer by popularity first and resolve migration and compatibility afterward
options.feedback: Changing many layers expands risk and diagnosis scope, while popularity does not prove fit.

options.label: List product names without saying which one owns UI, data, or deployment
options.feedback: A brand list hides responsibilities, so overlaps, gaps, and replacement impact cannot be judged.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先读取项目配置并列出现有技术栈，按页面、交互、数据、后端和部署说明每项职责。不要先替换工具；对每个建议写清解决的问题、迁移范围、兼容风险和可验证收益。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Inspect project configuration and map the current stack by UI, interaction, data, backend, and deployment responsibilities. Replace nothing yet; for each proposal state the problem, migration scope, compatibility risk, and verifiable benefit.

learning.assumes: You know a web page can open, accept input, and respond to clicks.
learning.outcome: You can separate the jobs of building a page, styling it, and running a site in a small project.

modules.title: Which tools make a to-do app run?
How a set of tools becomes one working project

items.title: Write the content
items.text: The page needs source files before a browser can show anything.

items.title: Connect the roles
items.text: Some tools organize the page, some set spacing and color, and others start it on a computer or server.

items.title: Use only what fits
items.text: A combination that opens, responds, and ships the current project is enough.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A tech stack is not a required shopping list. A common beginner-friendly full-stack for vibe coding is: Next.js (framework) + Tailwind CSS (styling) + shadcn/ui (components) + Supabase (database) + Vercel (hosting), but the right stack depends on the project needs.
